state:
**Side goal `website-overhaul`, stage 2 in progress.** The nav, the per-area sidebars and the removals are on disk. The header is Guides, Syntax, Reference, In-Depth (each with its subtitle), Install as a button, then Sponsoring, all read from `AREAS` and `INSTALL` in `website/config/site.mjs`, which the footer, the mobile menu and `llms.txt` read too. `website/src/routeData.ts` narrows the sidebar to the current area's top-level group and gives a page outside every area no sidebar. `<Pagination/>` is gone. The rulebook pages, `rules.json`, `website-rules.ts`, the decisions page and `decisions.json`, Why Novis and its claims, and the site index are deleted; `nv decisions --render` writes only `docs/decisions.md`. The Core pages moved to `/reference/core/`, installation and hello-world to `/install/`, release notes to `/in-depth/what-changed/`. No `/docs/` URL remains and no redirect exists. The area landing pages are short placeholders that stages 4 to 6 replace.

The site has not been built since: the worktree has no `website/node_modules`, so `npm ci` in `website/` comes before the first `bun nv site --build`.
